candidates.name: Pea-Green Textured Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The texture can serve Casual or Travel, but the actual muted-khaki color, long open overshirt body, large flap pocket and visible base T-shirt cannot communicate a self-contained Luxury Summer Office garment.

candidates.name: Pink Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The lively pink is outweighed by distressed plaid, raw fraying, a dropped shoulder and a very long open body. It reads Festival grunge, not Luxury Office.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Long-Sleeve Button-Down
candidates.decisionReason: The fresh color is shown only in a hanger composition over a separate tee, so fit, drape, fiber and hand-finishing remain unproven.

candidates.name: Khaki Mock-Neck Short-Sleeve Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only view provides no body-fit or drape proof, and the narrow ribbed sleeves, long tapered torso and flat muted knit read mass-market rather than Luxury.

candidates.name: White Mock-Neck Short-Sleeve Top
candidates.decisionReason: This plain product-only T-shirt shape has no visible fine-gauge character, body proof or silk-cashmere construction evidence.

candidates.name: White Short-Sleeve Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The lightweight hanger-only shirt is styled as an open layer over a tee and cannot establish Luxury fit, drape, fiber or finishing.

candidates.name: Light-Green Casual Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only source lacks fit proof, while asymmetric utility pockets, dark buttons and a visible wordmark patch conflict with quiet Luxury Office construction.

candidates.name: Pastel-Blue Clean Chino Short
candidates.decisionReason: The shiny product-only fabric, elastic side waist, rolled hem and narrow conventional cut cannot prove a Luxury tailored Bermuda.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Cotton-Linen Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: A gathered elastic waist, visible drawstring, crinkled surface and barefoot source read lounge or Resort rather than Luxury tailoring.

candidates.name: Gray Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The gathered waist, oversized cord, black D-ring, synthetic sheen and hidden shoe break override the otherwise controlled leg.

candidates.name: Navy Lightweight Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The dark technical fabric, zip detail and broad leg pooling over sneakers fail both Luxury hand-feel and precise Summer drape.

candidates.name: Camel Relaxed-Straight Cotton Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The camel cotton is useful for lower-tier Casual, but its long stacked hem and chunky-sneaker presentation do not establish a light Luxury Summer trouser.

candidates.name: Khaki Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The light texture can serve Resort, but the wrinkled product-only source, rolled long hem and absent fit proof do not meet a Luxury tailored-short gate.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Toile Knee-Length Short
candidates.decisionReason: The botanical toile and controlled line work for Resort or a daytime Party, but the all-over print and casual styling are not Luxury Office.

candidates.name: Sage Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only technical short uses a webbing belt, exposed zips and diagonal seams without fit proof, so it cannot serve as Luxury tailoring.
